caveat: This verifier invokes the deployed calibrate-ece Supabase Edge Function and validates only the redacted response shape and counts. It does not apply migrations, deploy functions, inspect raw expert labels, print secrets, or prove scientific validity beyond the returned sample.
functionPreconditions: The target Supabase project must already have the approved calibration migrations applied.
The deployed calibrate-ece function must have its own SUPABASE_SERVICE_ROLE_KEY configured in Supabase function secrets.
The target database must contain approved expert_assessments rows and APO logs with matching occupation codes.
doesNotProve: Scientific validation beyond the measured sample
manualInterventionIfSkipped: Confirm calibration migrations and the deployed calibrate-ece function are already approved for the target Supabase project.
Provide SUPABASE_URL or VITE_SUPABASE_URL and SUPABASE_ANON_KEY or VITE_SUPABASE_ANON_KEY for the target project.
Confirm the deployed function has SUPABASE_SERVICE_ROLE_KEY configured as a Supabase secret; do not put service-role values in chat or tracked files.
Run npm run verify:production-calibration. Review the redacted artifact and attach owner-held raw proof only through the live-gate evidence template.

checks.label: Production calibration target credentials are configured
checks.message: Required target URL and anon key were provided without printing secret values.

checks.label: ECE is a normalized finite value
checks.message: Expected calibration error is finite and within [0,1].

checks.label: Calibration joined live APO predictions to expert assessments
checks.message: The deployed function returned at least one matched prediction/expert pair.

checks.label: Calibration found expert assessment rows
checks.message: The deployed function returned at least one expert assessment row.

checks.label: Reliability bins were produced
checks.message: The deployed function produced reliability bins.

checks.label: Calibration run id is present
checks.message: The deployed function returned a calibration run id.
